title: Prediction of metabolic syndrome following a first pregnancy.
summary: Random forest and LASSO use pregnancy variables; SHAP variable reduction creates parsimonious risk model. 4,225 participants (754 cases); random forest AUROC .878 vs LASSO .850; reduced 3-variable model AUROC .867, test AUROC .847. Random 70/30 split only; retrospective secondary analysis of prospective cohort, noncausal risk prediction. Internal random split and cross-validation; no external cohort, limited cohort transportability. AI role: Random forest, LASSO and SHAP-based feature reduction. The article appeared in American Journal Of Obstetrics And Gynecology.
